summary: Elong Power Holding Ltd., a Beijing-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held October 30, 2026 (Beijing time), at which shareholders approved a special resolution to deregister as a Cayman Islands exempted company and continue as a British Virgin Islands business company — the offshore-law equivalent of a US reincorporation/domicile change. Outstanding were 929,541 Class A shares (one vote each) and 2,548 Class B shares (200 votes each); 13,324 Class A and all 2,548 Class B shares were represented, about 36.336% of voting power and sufficient for quorum. All proposals passed. No deal terms, price, or advisors were disclosed.
